Fixture: does the choice actually stick across page navigations?

Models OneTrust's real re-prompt rule: the banner is shown unless OptanonAlertBoxClosed is present. That cookie — not the group states in OptanonConsent — is what OneTrust checks to decide whether to ask again.

This exists because of a live report on cnbc.com: "every page view it consumes again". Consent WAS being recorded correctly in OptanonConsent, but nothing ever recorded that a choice had been made, so the banner returned on every navigation and the extension acted (and counted a cookie) every single time. The extension's job is to save the choice with the CMP so the site stops asking — not to dismiss the same modal forever.
